subject: Unexpected billing for trial tokens — request for credit issuance & VAT breakdown

From: Ibrahim Nassar <ibrahim.n@quantix.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-27T08:12:00Z
Subject: Trial signup — saw token charges on invoice (VAT?)

Hi Olga / Marissa,

We signed up yesterday and redeemed the PLG trial credits via the console (account QX-ACCT-5567). When I downloaded the invoice this morning there is a small token charge (0.12 EUR) plus VAT on top — we expected the trial to cover any usage during the trial window. Can you confirm whether the trial credits were applied and why we see a charge?

Our finance team is asking for a quick explanation and whether you can issue a credit if this was applied in error. Also any guidance on how VAT is being calculated would help (we're EU-based, VAT ID: NL123456789B01).

Invoice reference: invoice_QX-0427.pdf (attached)

Thanks,
Ibrahim
Head of Platform
Quantix.ai

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-27T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Trial signup — saw token charges on invoice (VAT?)

Hi Ibrahim — thanks for flagging this and sorry for the confusion. Quick notes: 

- Our PLG trial credits are normally applied automatically at invoice time, but in a few edge cases a small charge can be posted by the payment processor before the credit is reconciled.
- We can issue a reversal credit for the charged tokens and generate a credit memo for your records.

Can you attach the invoice PDF and confirm the account id (looks like QX-ACCT-5567) and the VAT number you provided? I'll loop in our billing lead (Sean) to handle the credit memo and ensure VAT is reflected properly.

Proposed immediate action:
- Please send the invoice PDF (if you haven't attached it)
- We'll provisionally apply a credit while we investigate and extend your trial window by 7 days to make up any lost time

I'll follow up once Sean confirms the credit note.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: quick billing review — Quantix (QX-ACCT-5567)

Internal notes (not sent to customer yet):

I pulled invoice_QX-0427.pdf. Looks like Stripe posted a tiny authorization/charge before our credits reconciled; tax line was calculated by the payment processor. We should: 

1) Issue a reversal credit for the 0.12 EUR token charge.
2) Create a credit memo that reduces the taxable base so their VAT liability is zeroed (finance will need a formal credit memo for their ledger).
3) Apply a 7-day trial extension on the account since usage occurred during what should have been covered by the trial.

Monica — can you process a manual credit memo and attach the PDF to the customer record? Mark as urgent for EU VAT handling.

Attachment: billing_notes_0428.txt (internal)

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-04-29T14:00:00Z
Subject: Credit memo issued for invoice_QX-0427 — Quantix.ai

Hi Ibrahim — Monica from Billing Ops here.

Thanks for the invoice; we've processed the reversal and created a formal credit memo. Actions completed:

- Issued a credit for the charged amount (0.12 EUR) and generated credit_memo_QX-0429.pdf (attached).
- Adjusted your account balance so no charge is due.
- Extended your trial window by 7 days (new trial end: 2026-05-08).
- The credit memo reduces the taxable base; VAT is therefore removed on the net amount — the attached PDF includes the fields your finance team usually requires (credit memo number, original invoice reference, VAT breakdown).

HubSpot link to the deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/QX-2026-0427

Attachment: credit_memo_QX-0429.pdf (PDF)

If your finance team needs a different format or an emailed letter on company letterhead, let me know and I can escalate.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
